bug_semantics: In net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c, udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync() unconditionally queue_work()s utn->work and sets work_pending=1 without first checking whether the work is already queued or running. The workqueue core clears its internal pending bit before the worker executes, so a concurrent udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync() during that window queues the work a second time; when the already-running udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync_work() worker finishes it executes `utn->work_pending = 0`, which clears the flag belonging to the second, still-queued instance. udp_tunnel_nic_unregister() then sees work_pending==0, believes the pending work is done, and frees the udp_tunnel_nic (kfree(utn->entries), kfree(utn)) while the second work item is still in the queue — the subsequently running worker dereferences freed memory: use-after-free with debugobjects warnings (CWE-415/CWE-416 class).
flaw_origin: Commit cc4e3835eff474aa274d6e1d18f69d9d296d3b76 ("udp_tunnel: add central NIC RX port offload infrastructure", 2020-07-09, author Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>, committer David S. Miller) introduced net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c wholesale, including the exact racy pattern the advisory names: `queue_work(udp_tunnel_nic_workqueue, &utn->work); utn->work_pending = 1;` in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync() with no work_pending guard on the queue side, the worker's `utn->work_pending = 0;` in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync_work(), and unregister's `if (utn->work_pending) return;` gate preceding the kfrees. The parent tree (84a4160e5a5951357947ad296932b433de3e34a0) has no net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c (cat-file -e fails). The fix commit's own Fixes: tag cites cc4e3835eff4, confirming this is the BIC. The race window existed from day one; the advisory's CVE-2026 date reflects Yue Sun's 2026 report, not the introduction.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org> and committer David S. Miller (2020-07-09), message plus v4 sign-off chain entirely human; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object.
evidence: Advisory (CVE-2026-72405 / GHSA-w888-j23q-c78g, kernel CVN entry): 'net: udp_tunnel: prevent double queueing in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync'; Yue Sun reported UAF and debugobjects warning in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync_work() during concurrent device operations; stable backports at git.kernel.org/stable/c/54292b167466..., 9075efb9b2c1..., cee6688e5731..., ecf69d4b4337....

Fix diff (ecf69d4b, mainline, 2026-06-25, Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>, committer Jakub Kicinski, Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260625065938.654652-2-edumazet@google.com): one line in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync(): `-\tif (!utn->need_sync)` `+\tif (!utn->need_sync || utn->work_pending)`. Its Fixes: tag reads `Fixes: cc4e3835eff4 (\"udp_tunnel: add central NIC RX port offload infrastructure\")`, and its message is verbatim the advisory text (Reported-by: Yue Sun, Suggested-by: Jakub Kicinski).

BIC creation check: `git show cc4e3835eff4:net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c` contains `queue_work(udp_tunnel_nic_workqueue, &utn->work); utn->work_pending = 1;` (device_sync, no guard), worker `utn->work_pending = 0;` (device_sync_work), and unregister `if (utn->work_pending) return;` before `kfree(utn->entries[i]); kfree(utn->entries); kfree(utn)`; parent 84a4160e lacks net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c entirely (introducer_parent_absent=true).

Branch topology: BIC first ships in tag v5.9-rc1 (tag --contains head); the four advisory fix shas are stable backports of one mainline patch: ecf69d4b on linux-7.2.y and ancestor of master (verified via merge-base --is-ancestor), 54292b16 on linux-7.1.y/rolling-stable, 9075efb9 on linux-6.18.y/rolling-lts, cee6688e on linux-6.12.y — all identical one-line change (git log --all --grep 'prevent double queueing' -- net/ipv4/udp_tunnel_nic.c returns exactly these four plus unrelated 4fca0f83 'udp_tunnel: remove rtnl_lock dependency').

A later stacked fix 080695e6f005e2396f1207fd69d24c442cb230c6 (2026-07-24, 'net: udp_tunnel: fix memory leak in udp_tunnel_nic_unregister()', [Upstream commit ...], backported as b322532a4b77) addresses a separate leak when work_pending causes early return on failed registration; it is not the CVE-2026-72405 fix and does not alter the BIC attribution.

Miller and a human sign-off chain (no claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored); the fix commit ecf69d4b likewise carries only human identities (Eric Dumazet, Yue Sun reporter, Jakub Kicinski committer).
reasoning: Vulnerability first: the advisory describes a double-queue race in udp_tunnel_nic_device_sync() that turns work_pending into a false 'done' signal, causing unregister to free a live udp_tunnel_nic — a UAF. The fix adds exactly the missing `|| utn->work_pending` guard, proving the queue-side guard's absence is the flaw. BIC choice: the fix's own Fixes: tag points to cc4e3835eff4 (2020), which created the file with the unguarded queue_work, the worker-side clear, and the unregister gate as one coherent design; the parent tree lacks the file, so the BIC is the introducer and no earlier ancestor carries the pattern. Squash check: the BIC is a single large feature commit (central NIC RX port offload infrastructure), not a decomposed squash of independent fixes; squash_decomposed=false. AI decision: BIC-only attribution — the 2020 commit object carries only human identities with no AI marker (kernel-era commit predates any AI coding assistant), so NOT_AI. The four advisory-listed stable shas are identical backports; the mainline patch ecf69d4b (master-ancestor) is recorded as fix_sha/direct_fix_sha.
